segments.name: Medical diagnostics
segments.description: Develops and commercializes blood-based biomarker tests and predictive analytic products and services to improve maternal and neonatal health.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating segment, which is developing and commercializing its medical diagnostic products and services.

revenueModel.text: The company generates revenue from sales of its PreTRM blood-based test to patients, physicians, and health care payers in the United States.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's revenue was generated in the U.S. for all periods presented and its assets are all located in the United States.
